My Apology Letter

My dearest Ann,

I am writing this with my whole heart, because some things are too important to leave unsaid. I am sorry. I am sorry for every mistake I have made since the day I started loving you.

I am sorry for the times I hurt you, for the words I should not have said, and for the moments I stayed silent when I should have spoken. I am sorry for the times I did not listen, for the times I let you down, and for every time I did not make you feel as special as you truly are. You deserved better, and I know it.

You are my world, Ann. You make my days brighter, my heart lighter and my life better. When I think of the future, I see you in it. I have not always shown that the way I should have, but my love for you is real and it has never changed.

I am not only saying sorry, I am promising to change. I will listen more. I will be more patient and more honest. I will think before I speak, and I will choose kindness even when I am upset. I will not repeat the mistakes that hurt you, and I will keep working every day to become the man you deserve.

Thank you for your patience, for your beautiful heart, and for every time you chose to stay. I do not take it for granted. Please forgive me, and let me love you the right way.

Today, tomorrow and always, I choose you.

Forever yours, ❤
Clinton Wentz
